unfunded.say: Tails. You pay double, and he bows to the crowd. The pie's good, which almost makes up for it. Almost.
He mates you in eleven moves without breaking off his sausage. You put your coin in his tin. He tells you what you did wrong, in detail, and he's right about all of it.

performance: You hold the glamour for three hours, pale and see-through, and walk through the wall on cue, and the gods scream. At the curtain Vey is delighted. "I was watching for the join all night," she says, "and I never found it." The papers mention the ghost.
falseTruth: You tell her, gently, you've never been on a stage in your life. She doesn't believe you. She thinks you're being modest. She walks off telling her friend she met the villain and the villain was very modest, and you're left a little sorry not to be.

failedLie.say: You get halfway through the trapdoor before she says, "But the villain was a man of sixty," and lets go of your arm, and tells the whole street what you are, at length.

emptyPurse.say: It goes up a drainpipe and along a gutter and is gone. When you get back the organ-grinder hands back your purse, lighter by a coin "for the monkey's trouble". You can't prove a thing.
